description:
Diatronome is a 3-in-1 android application. It provides a tuner,
a visual-metronome, and a synthesizer.
Features:
- Adjustable references pitch
- Transposition support
- Visual indicator for tuner and metronome
- Continuous synthesizer mode
- Capture tempo (central click on metronome)
- Multiple customizable settings (including app color)
- Advanced parameters available to work on a wide range of devices.
Audio recording and playback permissions are required to run.
The application provides an useful practice tools for musicians.
Keywords: metronome, tuner, synthesizer
